## Conversions Tab

The Conversions tab under the Product Editor contains non-datetime effective options and is available when the user selects a product name from the product tree.

Product conversion is the process of re-classifying a product as a another product. The Conversions Tab allows users to specify what product another product can be converted to when creating a product conversion ticket in the Ticket Editor or Ticket Search. If no valid products are specified for conversion to, then a product cannot be converted to any other product.

**Example:** An example of a product conversion is when two products follow each other in a pipeline. Where the two products meet there is an interface layer which may be reclassified as one of the two products or possibly as a slop product to be reprocessed. Another example is in a storage cavern. The cavern may have propane in it and off spec propane is added to it. The propane that was initially in the cavern may now need to be reprocessed and so it may be converted to demethanized mix.

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Set up a Product Conversion</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Set up">

To convert from one product to another or reclassify a product as another product, the user needs to specify Valid Product Conversions. When creating a product conversion ticket, only products that have a Valid Product Conversion defined can be selected as the From product. Once the From product is selected, only products that are set up as a Valid Product Conversion for the selected product will be available to convert to.

**Example:** The user may have three products set up in FLOWCAL: propane, Y-grade and crude oil. If the user's propane is off spec and it needs to be reprocessed, it would be valid to convert it to Y-grade, but converting it to crude oil would not be sensible. Similarly, crude oil cannot be converted to Y-grade or propane, so given those product choices, it would not be setup with any Valid Product Conversions. Limiting what products can be converted to reduces the opportunity for errors to be made by the user.

<div class="procedure">

To convert a product:

1.  Select the product name to convert.
2.  Select a product from the drop-down at the bottom of the Valid Product Conversion box.
3.  Click **Add**.

</div>

</div>
